name: Nova Zanuthar
source: A suspicious guest who seems to know people in high places and always get what they want. [spoiler]They change their name all the time, but their real name is Val. They enjoy life by stealing from the rich. They become attracted to the protagonist as they share similar values.[/spoiler]
